note: PROVENANCE: hand written to Apify's documented run-start schema, like every other entry in this directory - tests/base.py calls these 'hand written provider fixtures'. NOT captured from a live run. No Apify actor run in this repository has ever succeeded: providers/apify.start_run records that every run it started was rejected with 400 invalid-input for a missing proxyConfiguration, so there is nothing to capture from. scripts/capture_researchpack.py takes the real ones and costs credits.

One SUCCEEDED per run id, each naming ITS OWN dataset. A generic status reply made the run fall through to apify.json's catch-all `/datasets/` entry and read another actor's rows - which is what a shared match does when the ids do not discriminate.
